unpopulatedChromiumMetrics.reason: Verified at 0 through an 8M-iteration pure-JS loop that consumed 11.7 ms of ThreadTime on Chromium 156. Treated as unavailable rather than reported as zero-cost.

metricDefinitions.cpuThreadMs: Chromium Performance.getMetrics ThreadTime delta: main-thread CPU time, including the forced style/layout flush and any GC. Primary CPU figure.
metricDefinitions.cpuTaskMs: TaskDuration delta: total time in main-thread tasks.
metricDefinitions.cpuStyleMs: RecalcStyleDuration delta. cpuLayoutMs: LayoutDuration delta. Only nonzero because each phase ends by forcing a flush; Chromium otherwise defers rendering to a later frame.
metricDefinitions.mountWallMs: Page-reported wall clock for tree construction, first render and the forced flush, excluding root creation.
metricDefinitions.updateWallMs: Page-reported wall clock for all updates, each including tree construction and a forced flush.
metricDefinitions.treeMs: Element-tree construction only, split out of the wall clock for both phases.
metricDefinitions.renderMs: Wall clock minus tree construction: the framework's render/commit plus the forced style and layout flush. Not render alone.
metricDefinitions.retainedTreeBytes: JS heap after forced GC with the tree mounted, minus heap after forced GC with only input data retained. Cost of holding one rendered tree.
metricDefinitions.allocatedBytes: Heap immediately after the update phase with no GC, minus the post-mount GC'd heap. Allocation pressure; mostly collectable garbage.
metricDefinitions.retainedGrowthBytes: Heap after forced GC post-update minus post-mount. Growth that survives collection.
metricDefinitions.frameworkResidualBytes: Heap after unmount plus forced GC minus the input-data baseline, with benchmark inputs still retained. A single cycle cannot separate a true leak from framework caches or GC timing, so treat this as residual heap, not proven leakage.
metricDefinitions.pageResidualBytes: Heap after unmount, input release and forced GC minus the empty-page heap measured post-warmup. Same caveat as frameworkResidualBytes.
metricDefinitions.nodesMounted: Memory.getDOMCounters node delta while mounted. nodesAfterUnmount: node delta after unmount; nonzero indicates retained or detached DOM.
metricDefinitions.inputAllocation: Benchmark input rows are materialized before the heap baseline, so they are excluded from every memory delta.
metricDefinitions.measurementNote: DOM assertions run in a separate page phase outside every CPU window. Each run uses a fresh browser context and a fresh CDP session.

metadata.timing: production browser bundles; CPU from Chromium cumulative counter deltas; memory from Runtime.getHeapUsage after forced GC
